scope: Root inspected head, breast, feet, mantle, side and three-quarter authoring renders over nine iterations. Current model retained for browser and articulation review. Independent head/body reviewer confirms remaining likeness limits; their neck observations are self-review.

findings.finding: Closed orbital mounting plate and nasal hood remove the detached eye and large roof gap. Cheek/mandible pieces preserve sampled jaw clearance. Broad smooth shields and simplified nested bearing construction remain below source likeness.

Outward-oriented surfaces and regular quad mantle lofts remove sliver artifacts. Restored overlapping coverts and multiple distal tiers close exposed pod bands. Breast and mantle still read too regular and broad compared with source plate hierarchy.
Cervical laminae provide more coverage; ankle sheaths are segmented, bearings annular and talon profiles narrower. Coarse leg/digit mass and repeated neck fields remain visible.
Named supported floor scrape, recovery/interruption handling and distinct cage-action timing are implemented. Actual geometry tests and exact-model browser evidence are recorded separately.
findings.status: technical checks bounded; no physical-force or owner acting certification

acceptance: No numerical score, final exterior, material approval, owner acceptance or publication is claimed.
